data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

data.page_content_preview:
Coded Culinary

Blueberry Scones Recipe

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 20 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Let cool slightly before serving.

data.page_title: Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

data.content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Stir wet ingredients into dry ingredients until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 1-inch thick circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to baking sheet.
  9. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  10. Cool on wire rack before serving.

Tips

For extra sweetness, brush scones with cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar before baking. Serve warm with clotted cream or jam.

Recipe published on 2024-08-15 | All rights reserved.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder

  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.

data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

data.loaded_content:
Blueberry Scones

These tender, flaky blueberry scones are bursting with fresh berries and have a lovely crumbly texture with just the right amount of sweetness.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work it into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla.
  6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on prepared baking sheet.
  9. Brush tops with additional cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
  11. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Nutrition Information

Serving size: 1 scone | Calories: 285 | Total fat: 14g | Carbohydrates: 36g | Protein: 4g

Tips & Variations

  • Use frozen blueberries for year-round availability
  • Add lemon zest...[truncated]

  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

*   **Prep time:** 15 minutes
*   **Cook time:** 18 minutes
*   **Difficulty:** Easy

#### **Ingredients**
*   2 cups all-purpose flour
*   1/3 cup granulated sugar
*   1 tablespoon baking powder
*   1/2 teaspoon salt
*   6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
*   1 cup fresh blueberries
*   2/3 cup heavy cream
*   1 large egg
*   1 teaspoon vanilla extract
*   Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

#### **Instructions**
1.  **Preheat** oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2.  **Whisk** flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
3.  **Cut in** cold butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4.  **Fold** in the blueberries gently.
5.  **Whisk** cream, egg, and vanilla in a separate bowl, then stir into the dry ingredients until just combined.
6.  **Shape** dough into a 7-inch circle (1-inch thick) on a floured surface.
7.  **Cut** into 8 wedges and place on the baking sheet.
8.  **Brush** with cream, sprinkle with sugar, and **bake** for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.

data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
